name: Ashe
title: the Frost Archer

Q.name: Ranger's Focus
Q.description: Passive: Ashe's Attacks grant a stack for 4 seconds. At 4 stacks, she may activate this Ability. Active: Ashe gains 20/30/40/50/60% Attack Speed and her Attacks deal 1.1/1.15/1.2/1.25/1.3×AD damage instead for 6 seconds.
Q.summary: Ashe builds up Focus by attacking. At maximum Focus, Ashe can cast Ranger's Focus to consume all stacks of Focus, temporarily increasing her Attack Speed and transforming her basic attack into a powerful flurry attack for the duration.

W.name: Volley
W.description: Ashe fires a volley of 7/8/9/10/11 arrows, each dealing 60/95/130/165/200 + 1×bonus AD physical damage. Enemies can be hit by multiple arrows, but only take damage from the first.
W.summary: Ashe fires arrows in a cone for increased damage. Also applies Frost Shot.

E.name: Hawkshot
E.description: Ashe sends forth a hawk to grant vision for 5 seconds anywhere on the map. It also reveals the area around it as it flies. This Ability has 2 charges ((? × 90/80/70/60/50) second recharge).
E.summary: Ashe sends her Hawk Spirit on a scouting mission anywhere on the map.

R.name: Enchanted Crystal Arrow
R.description: Ashe launches a crystal arrow of ice that Stuns the first champion hit and deals 200/400/600 + 1.2×AP magic damage. The Stun duration increases with distance travelled, up to 3.5 seconds. Surrounding enemies are Slowed by Frost Shot.
R.summary: Ashe fires a missile of ice in a straight line. If the arrow collides with an enemy Champion, it deals damage and stuns the Champion, stunning for longer the farther arrow has traveled. In addition, surrounding enemy units take damage and are slowed.

Passive.name: Frost Shot
Passive.description: Ashe's attacks slow their target, causing her to deal increased damage to these targets. Ashe's critical strikes deal no bonus damage but apply an empowered slow to the target.
Passive.summary: Ashe's attacks slow their target, causing her to deal increased damage to these targets. Ashe's critical strikes deal no bonus damage but apply an empowered slow to the target.

source: Community Dragon latest (live patch) game files + client data

profile.identity: Utility marksman who slows with every attack and starts fights with a long-range R stun.
strengths: Permanent slows on attacks make her hard to escape
Long-range R stun starts fights or catches
profile.curveNote: Trades with autos and W from level 1; R is her big spike.

Q.notes: Empowers her attacks for a few seconds.

W.notes: Cone of arrows; blockable by Yasuo W / Braum E.

R.notes: Global missile; stun longer with distance; blockable by projectile blocks and spell shields.

profile.windowAgainst: R on cooldown, or she's been caught without Flash.
